name: Andros Lakes Race
description: 8 editions, all now confirmed by the organizer's own 'Previous Editions' page (androslakesrace.com, live site is 'Coming Soon' but archived 2025-02-12 via Wayback Machine): First (2019-04-07), Second (2019-10-20), Third (2020-11-15), Fourth (2022-05-15), Fifth (2023-06-04), Sixth (2024-05-26), Seventh (2025-06-01, per the site's own announcement), Eighth (2026-04-18/19). No 2021 race: Vol 4 was planned for 2021-05-16 (raceez.com) but held in 2022 instead, most likely a Covid-era postponement — no source states a formal cancellation. Organizer throughout: Athlete Trotter (business ID 3702736678).

Halong Bay Heritage Marathon
description: Started 2015 as "Halong Bay Half Marathon" (5km/21km only), renamed Halong Bay Heritage Marathon from 2016 (added 42km/10km). Ran every year 2015-2020. A 2021 edition was announced/promoted (Jan 2021 press coverage) but no results, ticket page or other confirmation it ran were found; most likely cancelled in Vietnam's mid-2021 Covid wave, not confirmed either way. Resumed 2022-2023 and again 2024 onward, now also known by its Vietnamese name Giải Marathon Quốc tế Di sản Hạ Long. Researched 2026-09-27, archived at .agent-read-archive/2026-09-27-halong-bay-heritage-marathon-research.

name: IRONKIDS Viet Nam in Da Nang
IRONKIDS Viet Nam in Phu Quoc
Lamdong Trail
description: 5 editions found so far, all in Đà Lạt: 2022 (2022-11-11/13, organizer VietnamJoy with Sở VHDL&TT Lâm Đồng, distances 3/10/21/45/70km, this appears to be the inaugural edition per iRace/tuoitre.vn coverage), 2023 (2023-11-10/12, 5/15/25/45/75km), 2024 (2024-11-08/10, 5/15/25/45/75km, organizer now GreenHat), 2025 (2025-11-07/09, 5/15/25/55/85km, the 85km course debuted this year), 2026 (2026-11-06/08, 5/15/25/55/85km, currently open for registration). No edition numbers ('lần thứ N') found stated by any source, so `edition` is left null on every race. Dates for 2022-2025 sourced from iRace (app.irace.vn results pages / irace.vn event pages, some via Wayback Machine since irace.vn overwrites its event URL each year) and lamdongtrail.vn's own recap articles (via Wayback, since the live site is overwritten for the current edition). Full tiered prices (Regular tier, 15/25/45/75km, VND) found for every edition 2022-2026 from ticket price images/pages (iRace for 2022-2023, ActiUp for 2024, lamdongtrail.vn for 2025-2026): 2022 899k/1,599k/1,999k/2,399k, 2023 999k/1,888k/2,222k/2,666k, 2024 1,499k/2,299k/2,499k/3,099k, 2025 950k/1,550k(25km)/2,050k(55km)/2,650k(85km), 2026 1,050k/1,700k(25km)/2,250k(55km)/2,900k(85km) — steady year-over-year increases, with a distance-mix change in 2025 (dropped 45/75km, added 55/85km) that breaks a clean like-for-like comparison at the top end.

name: Lý Sơn Cross Island
description: An open-water swim event (giải bơi vượt biển Lý Sơn), not a run — 1km/2km/5km swim distances. Distinct from the separate Lý Sơn Half Marathon series (a road run) by the same organizer.

name: Lý Sơn Half Marathon
description: Road half-marathon (5km/10km/21km), held annually since 2024. Its own official site (lysonhalfmarathon.com) went offline sometime after mid-2025 with no Wayback snapshot of its inner pages.

name: Standard Chartered Marathon Di sản Hà Nội
SUNRISE SPRINT Viet Nam in Da Nang
SUNRISE SPRINT Viet Nam in Phu Quoc
TAY HO HALF MARATHON - POWERED BY BIM GROUP
Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon
description: 9 editions tracked, run by Sunrise Events Vietnam with Techcombank as strategic sponsor. 1st edition 2017-11-26 (over 5,000 runners, no 5km category, per giaoduc.net.vn's 2017 recap and a Techcombank 2018-announcement quote calling it "mùa giải đầu tiên"). 2nd (2018-12-02, confirmed "mùa giải năm thứ 2" by Techcombank's own 2018 announcement), 3rd (2019-12-08, per its program booklet), 4th (originally scheduled Dec 2020, postponed for Covid-19, actually held 2021-04-11, confirmed by Sở VHTT/hochiminhcity.gov.vn coverage), 5th (2022-12-11, "Mùa thứ 5" marking the marathon's 5-year anniversary per Techcombank's own announcement), 6th (2023-12-10, over 15,000 participants), 7th (2024-12-08), 8th (2025-12-07, over 23,000 athletes from 81 countries, largest marathon in Vietnam's history), and 9th (2026-12-06, currently tracked/upcoming). Prices only confirmed for the 9th edition so far (official price-table images on marathonhcmc.com); editions 1-8 have no recovered price data yet.

name: GIẢI VÔ ĐỊCH QUỐC GIA MARATHON BÁO TIỀN PHONG
VnExpress Marathon Hồ Chí Minh
description: 4 editions tracked: 2023-02-12 (1st, per the 2024 race-info page's own "Sau mùa giải đầu tiên" wording), 2024-03-03 ("Mùa thứ 2", 2nd), 2025-02-23 ("Mùa thứ 3", 3rd), and 2026-03-22 (currently tracked, upcoming; confirmed "Mùa thứ tư" (4th) by vnexpress.net's own registration-opening article). All four editions offer 5km/10km/21km/42km. Prices for 2024 and 2025 recovered via Wayback snapshots of the official page taken during their sale windows (2024-01-21 and 2025-02-07) — the live vm.vnexpress.net pages drop the price table once a race is over. 2023 has no recoverable price: every Wayback capture of its main page during the sale window came back empty (426/0-byte crawl failures), and its /thong-tin-cuoc-dua subpage never carried a price table — a genuine gap, not skipped.

name: VnExpress Marathon Long Châu Cần Thơ
VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang
description: 5 editions tracked: Marvelous Nha Trang 2022-08-28 ("lần đầu tiên" i.e. 1st, per vm.vnexpress.net's own race-info page), Marvelous Nha Trang 2023-08-13 ("lần thứ hai", 2nd), Nha Trang 2024-08-11 ("Lần thứ 3"), Libera Nha Trang 2025-08-24 ("Lần thứ 4"), and Nha Trang 2026-08-09 (currently tracked, upcoming; its race-info page does not state an edition number). A planned VnExpress Marathon Marvelous Nha Trang 2021 (originally 2021-09-19) was postponed due to Covid-19 and became the 2022 edition (1st), not a separate one (confirmed via vnexpress.net's own postponement article and the 2022 page's "first time" wording) — not tracked as its own race. Past editions (2022-2025) have no price data: their vm.vnexpress.net pages no longer carry a ticket-price section once the sale period ends, and no distances were stated on the pages read.

name: VnExpress Marathon Quy Nhơn
description: The system's oldest race, first held 2019-06-09. No race in 2021 (COVID-19; VnExpress ran only online/livestream events that year across the whole system, per vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/VnExpress_Marathon and the organizer's own site history page). Editions: 1=2019, 2=2020, 3=2022, 4=2023, 5=2024, 6=2025, 7=2026 (each stated by the organizer's own pages, e.g. quy-nhon-2022's /thong-tin-cuoc-dua says "mùa thứ ba" and the 2026 gioi-thieu-chung history page confirms 2022 as "mùa thứ ba" too).

name: VnExpress Marathon Vũng Tàu
description: Vũng Tàu's first edition, 2026-08-30 (the series' 12th city per its own vnexpress.net launch article). No prior editions found in research 2026-09-27.

name: VPBank Đất Sen Hồng Music Marathon
description: Started 2022 as "Giải Marathon Đất Sen Hồng - Đồng Tháp" on dongthapmarathon.com (no VPBank branding yet); VPBank joined as co-organizer from the 2025 edition onward, and the site moved to datsenhongmarathon.com. 2022 ("lần thứ I", baocantho.com.vn), 2024 ("lần thứ 3", irace.vn), 2025 ("mùa giải thứ 4", a Wayback snapshot of ticket.irace.vn from during the 2025 sale window — the live irace.vn/nhandan.vn/baomoi.com pages found do not state it) and 2026 ("Mùa giải thứ 5", tuoitre.vn/irace.vn) all state their own edition number explicitly, so the run is fully numbered edition 1-5. 2023 is placed as edition 2 only by inference from a 2024 article comparing turnout to "mùa giải lần 2" — not stated on the 2023 race's own pages. The 2023 race's price table on the org's own site (dongthapmarathon.com, Sept 2023 snapshot) was found to be a stale, un-updated 2022 widget, not real 2023 prices — deliberately left empty rather than misattributed.

name: VPBank Hanoi International Marathon
description: 4 editions tracked (2023-10-08, 2024-10-13, 2025-10-26, 2026-10-18), all found via race-research, none previously in our data. VPBank's own homepage (vpbankmarathon.com) calls 2026 'mùa giải thứ 7' (the 7th season it has organized) and Báo Thanh Niên independently called 2025 'the 6th edition' — the two agree on the sequence, so edition is set 6/7 on those two races, but that count implies a start around 2020, which conflicts with a 2023-03-16 Báo Quân đội Nhân dân announcement describing VPIM as a brand-new race launching that October. Left unresolved: this VPIM series is distinct in our data from the older 'Hanoi Marathon / Hanoi International Heritage Marathon' lineage (2018-2022, later renamed Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race per Wikipedia) — same city and VPBank sponsorship history, different October vs November race dates, so treated as a separate series rather than merged, but the two could genuinely be the same organizing lineage under a discontinuity in VPBank's own counting.
